select t1.name as procedureStepName,t1.start_time,t1.complete_time as endTime,t1.procedure_step_model_id t1.update_by as completeUserId,t1.process_change_number,t1.procedure_change_number, t3.name as procedureName from bm_procedure_task_instance_history t1 left join bm_procedure_step_model t2 on t1.procedure_step_model_id = t2.id left join bm_procedure_model t3 on t1.procedure_model_id = t3.id where t1.is_deleted = 0 and t1.plan_id = #{productPlanId} and t2.node_function = #{nodeFunction}
and t3.name like concat('%',#{procedureName}, '%')
and t2.name like concat('%',#{procedureStepName}, '%')
order by t1.complete_time desc

SELECT t1.*, t2.node_id AS nodeId, t2.`name` as procedureName FROM bm_procedure_task_instance_history AS t1 JOIN bm_procedure_model AS t2 ON t1.procedure_model_id = t2.id WHERE t1.is_deleted = 0 AND t2.is_deleted = 0 AND t1.plan_id =#{planId} and t1.flow_state =#{state} GROUP BY t1.procedure_model_id,t1.process_change_number

SELECT t2.`name` as procedureName, t1.`name` as procedureStepName, t1.process_change_number as processChangeNum, t1.procedure_change_number as procedureStepNum, t1.active_time as procedureStepStartTime, t1.complete_time as procedureStepEndTime, t1.update_by as completer FROM bm_procedure_task_instance_history AS t1 JOIN bm_procedure_model AS t2 ON t1.procedure_model_id = t2.id where t1.is_deleted = 0 and t2.is_deleted = 0 and t1.flow_state = 'COMPLETE' and t1.plan_id =#{planId}
